note: All six families come from one opened source: the Hays Saudi Arabia Salary Guide 2026 PDF, downloaded directly from hays.ae on 2026-11-20 (no form, no login). Figures are total fixed MONTHLY package in SAR as of Q4 2025, read from the rendered table pages (the PDF text layer misaligns rows, so every number was checked against a render of the page). Hays gives job titles only, no junior/senior bands, and its titles skew to manager level: treat these as mid-to-senior ranges, not entry salaries.
